description: Pigment primitives. Values are absolute mineral pigments and paper grounds.

paper-100.role: Warm archival paper ground. Canonical page background.

paper-50.role: Lightest cream. Elevated surfaces, cards, inset highlights.

paper-200.role: Darker cream. Sunken wells, image placeholders, table hover.

ink-900.role: Charcoal ink. Primary text, heavy rules, pictogram strokes.

ink-700.role: Deep oak tone. Strong secondary text, metadata labels.

ink-500.role: Warm mineral gray. Secondary text, captions, hairlines.

moss-900.role: Deepest forest green. Display headings on light paper.

moss-700.role: Primary brand moss. Wordmark, OK status, active operations.

moss-500.role: Restrained moss. Secondary ground tone, soft borders.

coral-500.role: Terracotta accent. Rules, fills, badges, non-text graphic accents (3.93:1 on paper).

coral-700.role: Dark terracotta. Error status and AA-compliant text on paper (>4.5:1).

slate-500.role: Cool mountain stone. Technical neutral, ambient indicators.

sand-500.role: Warm neutral mushroom body tone. Surface fills, cards.

bark-700.role: Deep oak substrate brown. Infill blocks, inverted signage.

warning.role: Muted ochre caution pigment. Non-text use only (2.39:1 on paper).

warning-text.role: Darkened ochre. Only sanctioned ochre text color (4.83:1 on paper).
